Here is the step-by-step reasoning for each problem:

- **[id 90]**: An adult dinosaur eats $10\text{ lbs}$ and a child eats $10 / 2 = 5\text{ lbs}$. For $20$ adults and $5$ children: $(20 \times 10) + (5 \times 5) = 200 + 25 = 225\text{ lbs}$.
- **[id 91]**: Cindy has $4$ pets. Marcia has $4 + 2 = 6$ pets. Jan has $3 \times 6 = 18$ pets. In total: $4 + 6 + 18 = 28$ pets.
- **[id 92]**: James is $10$ and $1$ year younger than Corey, so Corey is $11$. Amy is $2$ years younger than Corey, so Amy is $9$. Amy is $5$ years older than Jackson, so Jackson is $9 - 5 = 4$ years old.
- **[id 93]**: Lee runs in $38\text{ seconds}$, which is $2\text{ seconds}$ faster than Gerald initially ($38 + 2 = 40\text{ seconds}$). A $10\%$ reduction in time is $40 \times 0.10 = 4\text{ seconds}$. With the improved diet, Gerald runs in $40 - 4 = 36\text{ seconds}$.
- **[id 94]**: With $60$ dogs and $2$ cats per dog, there are $2 \times 60 = 120$ cats (total $180$ cats and dogs). Rabbits are $12$ fewer than cats and dogs combined: $180 - 12 = 168$. Total pets: $180 + 168 = 348$.
- **[id 95]**: Out of $200$ students, $2/5$ are boys ($200 \times 2/5 = 80$), so there are $200 - 80 = 120$ girls. Of the girls, $2/3$ are in the scouts ($80$), leaving $120 - 80 = 40$ girls not in the scouts.
- **[id 96]**: Harry slept $9\text{ hours}$. James slept $9 \times 2/3 = 6\text{ hours}$. Harry slept $9 - 6 = 3\text{ hours}$ more than James.
- **[id 97]**: The sauce reduces by half, so $32\text{ oz}$ of sauce requires $32 \times 2 = 64\text{ oz}$ of canned tomatoes. At $16\text{ oz}$ per can, that is $64 / 16 = 4$ cans. With $3$ tomatoes per can: $4 \times 3 = 12$ tomatoes.
- **[id 98]**: Out of $30$ initial cars, $5$ took an exit, leaving $30 - 5 = 25$ cars that went through the jam. Since $20$ passed in the remaining $15$ minutes, $25 - 20 = 5$ cars passed in the first $15$ minutes.
- **[id 99]**: Mary already has $40 \times 2 = 80$ potted plants and received $18$ new ones, totaling $80 + 18 = 98$. Giving away $1$ plant from each of the $40$ ledges ($40$ plants) leaves $98 - 40 = 58$ potted plants.
